units.source_text: “我很同情埃及妇女，也觉得埃及的婚姻制度不好。

en.t: I deeply sympathize with Egyptian women, and I also think Egypt's marriage system is bad.

units.source_text: 不过，施行一夫多妻制的不止是埃及，

en.t: However, Egypt is not the only place that practices polygamy,

units.source_text: 它是包括土耳其和中国在内的东方的风俗习惯，

en.t: it is an Eastern custom that includes Turkey and China,

units.source_text: 自古以来就有漫长的历史，因此……”

en.t: and it has had a long history since ancient times, therefore..."
